name: ENNReal
tsum_toReal_eq
result.signature: {f : α → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : ∀ a, f a ≠ ∞) : (∑' a, f a).toReal = ∑' a, (f a).toReal
result.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {f : α → ENNReal}, (∀ (a : α), f a ≠ ⊤) → (∑' (a : α), f a).toReal = ∑' (a : α), (f a).toReal
result.value: := by simp only [ENNReal.toReal, tsum_toNNReal_eq hf, NNReal.coe_tsum]
result.informal_name: Truncation of Infinite Sums of Extended Non-Negative Reals
result.informal_description: For any function $ f : \alpha \to [0, \infty] $ with all values $ f(a) $ finite, the truncation of the infinite sum $ \sum_{a \in \alpha} f(a) $ to $ \mathbb{R} $ equals the infinite sum of the truncations $ \sum_{a \in \alpha} (f(a)).\text{toReal} $. This holds because mapping $ \infty \mapsto 0 $ commutes with summation when no terms are infinite.

name: NNReal
tsum_eq_toNNReal_tsum
result.signature: {f : β → ℝ≥0} : ∑' b, f b = (∑' b, (f b : ℝ≥0∞)).toNNReal
result.type: ∀ {β : Type u_2} {f : β → NNReal}, ∑' (b : β), f b = (∑' (b : β), ↑(f b)).toNNReal
result.value:
:= by
  by_cases h : Summable f
  · rw [← ENNReal.coe_tsum h, ENNReal.toNNReal_coe]
  · have A := tsum_eq_zero_of_not_summable h
    simp only [← ENNReal.tsum_coe_ne_top_iff_summable, Classical.not_not] at h
    simp only [h, ENNReal.toNNReal_top, A]
result.informal_name: Infinite Sum Truncation Equality for Non-negative Reals
result.informal_description: The infinite sum of a function $ f : \beta \to \mathbb{R}_{\geq 0} $ in the non-negative real numbers equals the truncation to $ \mathbb{R}_{\geq 0} $ of the infinite sum of $ f $ in the extended non-negative real numbers, i.e., $ \sum'_{b} f(b) = \left(\sum'_{b} (f(b) : \mathbb{R}_{\geq 0 \infty})\right).\text{toNNReal} $. This holds because the extended sum either converges finitely (matching the non-extended sum) or diverges to $ \infty $, which is truncated to 0 by $ \text{toNNReal} $.

name: ENNReal
hasSum_toReal
result.signature: {f : α → ℝ≥0∞} (hsum : ∑' x, f x ≠ ∞) : HasSum (fun x => (f x).toReal) (∑' x, (f x).toReal)
result.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {f : α → ENNReal}, ∑' (x : α), f x ≠ ⊤ → HasSum (fun x => (f x).toReal) (∑' (x : α), (f x).toReal)
result.value:
:= by
  lift f to α → ℝ≥0 using ENNReal.ne_top_of_tsum_ne_top hsum
  simp only [coe_toReal, ← NNReal.coe_tsum, NNReal.hasSum_coe]
  exact (tsum_coe_ne_top_iff_summable.1 hsum).hasSum
result.informal_name: Convergence of Truncated Extended Non-Negative Sums
result.informal_description: If the infinite sum $\sum_{x \in \alpha} f(x)$ in the extended non-negative real numbers $[0, \infty]$ is finite (i.e., not equal to $\infty$), then the corresponding infinite sum of the real numbers obtained by replacing $\infty$ with $0$ in each $f(x)$ converges in $\mathbb{R}$ to the same finite value.

name: ENNReal
tendsto_nat_tsum
result.signature: (f : ℕ → ℝ≥0∞) : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, f i) atTop (𝓝 (∑' n, f n))
result.type: ∀ (f : ℕ → ENNReal), Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, f i) Filter.atTop (nhds (∑' (n : ℕ), f n))
result.informal_name: Convergence of Partial Sums to Infinite Sum in ENNReal
result.informal_description: For any function $ f : \mathbb{N} \to [0, \infty] $, the sequence of partial sums $ \sum_{i=0}^{n-1} f(i) $ converges to the infinite sum $ \sum'_{n} f(n) $ as $ n \to \infty $, in the order topology on the extended non-negative real numbers $[0, \infty]$$.

name: finsum_eventually_eq_sum
result.signature:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {X : Type u_5} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {M : Type u_6} [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] {f : ι → X → M},
  (LocallyFinite fun i => Function.support (f i)) →
    ∀ (x : X), ∃ s, ∀ᶠ (y : X) in nhds x, ∑ᶠ (i : ι), f i y = ∑ i ∈ s, f i y
result.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {X : Type u_5} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {M : Type u_6} [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] {f : ι → X → M},
  (LocallyFinite fun i => Function.support (f i)) →
    ∀ (x : X), ∃ s, ∀ᶠ (y : X) in nhds x, ∑ᶠ (i : ι), f i y = ∑ i ∈ s, f i y
result.informal_name: Eventual Equality of Finite and Infinite Sums for Locally Finite Families
result.informal_description: In a topological space $X$ with functions taking values in an additive commutative monoid $M$, if the family of supports of functions $\{f_i\}$ is locally finite, then for every $x \in X$, there exists a finite set $s$ and a neighborhood of $x$ such that the infinite sum $\mathop{\text{finsum}}_{i : \iota} f_i(y)$ equals the finite sum $\sum_{i \in s} f_i(y)$ for all $y$ in this neighborhood.

name: Real
tendsto_pow_log_div_mul_add_atTop
result.signature: (a b : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (ha : a ≠ 0) : Tendsto (fun x => log x ^ n / (a * x + b)) atTop (𝓝 0)
result.type: ∀ (a b : ℝ) (n : ℕ), a ≠ 0 → Filter.Tendsto (fun x => Real.log x ^ n / (a * x + b)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)
result.value:
:=
  ((tendsto_div_pow_mul_exp_add_atTop a b n ha.symm).comp tendsto_log_atTop).congr' <| by
    filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop (0 : ℝ)] with x hx using by simp [exp_log hx]
result.informal_name: Limit of $\frac{(\ln x)^n}{a x + b}$ as $x \to \infty$ is zero
result.informal_description: For any real numbers $a \neq 0$ and $b$, and any natural number $n$, the function $\frac{(\ln x)^n}{a x + b}$ tends to $0$ as $x$ approaches infinity.

name: tendsto_log_mul_rpow_nhdsGT_zero
result.signature: {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) : Tendsto (fun x => log x * x ^ r) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)
result.type: ∀ {r : ℝ}, 0 < r → Filter.Tendsto (fun x => Real.log x * x ^ r) (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds 0)
result.value:
:=
  (tendsto_log_div_rpow_nhdsGT_zero <| neg_lt_zero.2 hr).congr' <|
    eventually_mem_nhdsWithin.mono fun x hx => by rw [rpow_neg hx.out.le, div_inv_eq_mul]
result.informal_description: For any real number $ r > 0 $, the product $ \log x \cdot x^r $ tends to 0 as $ x $ approaches 0 from the right.

name: Real
tendsto_pow_logb_div_mul_add_atTop
result.signature: (a c : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (ha : a ≠ 0) : Tendsto (fun x => logb b x ^ n / (a * x + c)) atTop (𝓝 0)
result.type: ∀ {b : ℝ} (a c : ℝ) (n : ℕ), a ≠ 0 → Filter.Tendsto (fun x => Real.logb b x ^ n / (a * x + c)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)
result.value:
:= by
  cases eq_or_ne (log b) 0 with
  | inl h => simpa [logb, h] using ((tendsto_mul_add_inv_atTop_nhds_zero _ _ ha).const_mul _)
  | inr h =>
    apply
      (tendsto_pow_log_div_mul_add_atTop (a * (log b) ^ n) (c * (log b) ^ n) n (by positivity)).congr fun x ↦ by
        simp [field, div_pow, logb]
result.informal_name: Limit of $ \frac{(\log_b x)^n}{a x + c} $ as $ x \to \infty $ is Zero
result.informal_description: For any real numbers $ a \neq 0 $ and $ c $, and any natural number $ n $, the function $ \frac{(\log_b x)^n}{a x + c} $ tends to 0 as $ x $ approaches infinity. This expresses that logarithmic growth raised to any power is asymptotically dominated by linear growth in the denominator.

name: isLittleO_log_rpow_atTop
result.signature: {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) : log =o[atTop] fun x => x ^ r
result.type: ∀ {r : ℝ}, 0 < r → Real.log =o[Filter.atTop] fun x => x ^ r
result.value:
:=
  calc
    log =O[atTop] fun x => r * log x := isBigO_self_const_mul hr.ne' _ _
    _ =ᶠ[atTop] fun x => log (x ^ r) := ((eventually_gt_atTop 0).mono fun _ hx => (log_rpow hx _).symm)
    _ =o[atTop] fun x => x ^ r := isLittleO_log_id_atTop.comp_tendsto (tendsto_rpow_atTop hr)
result.informal_name: Natural Logarithm is Little-o of x^r at Infinity for Positive r
result.informal_description: For any real number $ r > 0 $, the natural logarithm function $ \ln x $ is asymptotically negligible compared to $ x^r $ as $ x \to \infty $, i.e., $ \ln x = o(x^r) $ as $ x \to \infty $.

name: deriv_sqrt_mul_log'
result.signature: : (deriv fun x => √x * log x) = fun x => (2 + log x) / (2 * √x)
result.type: (deriv fun x => √x * Real.log x) = fun x => (2 + Real.log x) / (2 * √x)
result.informal_name: Derivative of √x ln x Equals (2 + ln x)/(2√x)
result.informal_description: For all real numbers $ x > 0 $, the derivative of the function $ f(x) = \sqrt{x} \ln x $ is given by $ \frac{2 + \ln x}{2\sqrt{x}} $.
